messages:
Priya Sinha: quick ping — opened a small PR that updates the KMS key policy conditions and wires an audit-log sink for key-rotation events. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/987. needs sec + sre eyes, pref before EOD.

Sanjay Patel: looking now. can you paste the policy snippet here (or point to the file)? want to check the principal/condition change.

Priya Sinha: snippet below — basically restricting key use to service accounts with `roles/compute.serviceAgent` and adding `kms.key.rotate` to audit sink events:
```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {
      "role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter",
      "members": ["serviceAccount:infra-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"],
      "condition": {
        "title": "only-infra-sa",
        "expression": "request.auth.claims.email == 'infra-sa@redwood-inference'"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Alex: will take first pass. quick note: CI (formatter) failed locally for me on a similar PR — might be the json linter. if it's failing here i can push a fix.

deploy-bot: CI / platform-ci — build #342: succeeded :white_check_mark:

Maria: does this change require any migration for Dedicated customers or is it purely control-plane? also, rollback plan?

Priya Sinha: purely control-plane config; Dedicated clusters won't need a data migration. rollback = revert PR, redeploy control-plane config. i'll add a short rollback note to the PR now.

Eve (sec): quick security notes: 1) we need retention for the audit sink set to >=90 days for rotation events; 2) can we include the key alias in log entries (so ops can correlate)? otherwise LGTM.

Priya Sinha: thanks — i'll add retention param and include `labels.key_alias` to the logged payload. pushing the change in a sec. do you want commits squashed or keep history?

Eve (sec): keep history is fine for traceability. please also add a short test that asserts `kms.key.rotate` shows up in the sink events. small unit test is ok.

Rob: i can give formal approval after the retention test lands. small nit: the policy condition should use `request.auth.token.email` vs `claims.email` for consistency with other policies.

Priya Sinha: good catch, will update to `request.auth.token.email`. pushing an amended commit.

Rob: thanks — reviewing the updated diff now.

Rob: LGTM. approving on GH in a minute. :white_check_mark:

Priya Sinha: thank you all. i'll merge after Rob's approval propagates and then monitor audit logs for the next rotation window. will post a short follow-up in #eng-oncall with validation steps. :rocket:
